tags.name: HourOfDay
tags.documentation: Simulated clock hour of day, 0-24 (advances SpeedFactor x real time; 120 = 24 h in 12 min).

tags.name: DayIndex
tags.documentation: Simulated days since the sim started; day 0 is a Monday (days 5 and 6 of each week are the weekend).

tags.name: Season
tags.documentation: WINTER|SPRING|SUMMER|AUTUMN from the day of year.

tags.name: IsWeekend
tags.documentation: Weekend day: no PEAK tariff band, lower building loads and EV traffic.

tags.name: SunElevationDeg
tags.documentation: Sun elevation above the horizon (latitude 37 N, from hour and day of year).

tags.name: ClearSkyIrradianceWm2
tags.documentation: Clear-sky global irradiance (Haurwitz model).

tags.name: IrradianceWm2
tags.documentation: Site irradiance after cloud attenuation (pyranometer).

tags.name: Cloudiness
tags.documentation: Effective cloud cover 0-1: random walk plus scheduled fronts, or the _Sim_/Cloudiness override.

tags.name: AmbientTempC
tags.documentation: Ambient temperature: seasonal mean, diurnal swing, cloud cooling.

tags.name: TariffBand
tags.documentation: OFFPEAK|SHOULDER|PEAK. Weekdays: OFFPEAK 22-07, SHOULDER 07-16 and 21-22, PEAK 16-21. Weekends: OFFPEAK 22-08, else SHOULDER.

tags.name: TariffRate
tags.documentation: Energy price for the present band.

tags.name: DemandWindow
tags.documentation: Weekday 16:00-21:00: the window in which grid stress management (smart EV curtailment, peak shaving) is active.

tags.name: GridCO2gPerKWh
tags.documentation: Grid carbon intensity: lower at midday (solar on the grid), highest in the evening ramp.

tags.documentation: Critical load: the only building served in island mode. Constant.

tags.documentation: Shed (not served) while islanded.

tags.documentation: Building 2 (Lab) load incl. HVAC; 0 while shed.

tags.name: HVACkW

tags.name: Critical
tags.documentation: Critical load: the only building served in island mode. Constant.

tags.name: Shed
tags.documentation: Shed (not served) while islanded.

tags.name: kW

tags.name: HVACkW
tags.documentation: HVAC part of the load (cooling above 17 C ambient, heating below 12 C).

tags.name: Critical
tags.documentation: Critical load: the only building served in island mode. Constant.

tags.name: Shed
tags.documentation: Shed (not served) while islanded.

tags.name: TotalkW
tags.documentation: Served campus load: buildings plus EV charging.

tags.name: CriticalkW
tags.documentation: Load of the critical buildings.

tags.name: BuildingsTotalkW
tags.documentation: Served building load (without EV).

tags.name: NetLoadkW
tags.documentation: Campus load minus PV output (negative = PV surplus).

tags.name: PVFractionPct
tags.documentation: Share of the served load covered by PV.

tags.name: SelfSufficiencyPct
tags.documentation: Share of the served load not imported from the utility.

tags.name: PVTotalkW
tags.documentation: Total PV AC output.

tags.name: BESSTotalkW
tags.documentation: Total BESS power (positive = discharging).

tags.name: TodayPVkWh
tags.documentation: PV energy today.

tags.name: TodaySavingsUSD
tags.documentation: Baseline cost minus actual cost today.

tags.name: TodayCO2AvoidedKg
tags.documentation: CO2 avoided today versus the no-PV/BESS baseline.

tags.name: ActiveAlarms
tags.documentation: Currently active alarms under MG (from the alarm system).

tags.name: Mode
tags.documentation: NORMAL|ISLAND|GENSET|CURTAILING|STRESS.

tags.name: PVkW
tags.documentation: Day-ahead PV forecast for the present hour (clear sky, typical cloudiness, no noise).

tags.name: LoadkW
tags.documentation: Day-ahead campus load forecast for the present hour (profiles, forecast temperature, expected EV; no noise, no heat wave).

tags.name: PricePerkWh
tags.documentation: Day-ahead tariff for the present hour.

tags.name: Enabled
tags.documentation: Master switch for the mg_sim timer.

tags.name: Scenario
tags.documentation: normal|grid_outage|cloud_front_ev_rush|peak_shave_day|inverter_fault.

tags.name: ScenarioStep
tags.documentation: Progress of the running scenario (see README).

tags.name: SpeedFactor
tags.documentation: Simulated seconds per real second (120 = 24 h in 12 min). Electrical transients scale with SpeedFactor/120 (0.25x-4x).

tags.name: Seed
tags.documentation: Random seed for the noise.

tags.name: TickCount
tags.documentation: Timer ticks since the sim started.

tags.name: LastTickMs
tags.documentation: Duration of the last tick's read + compute (the write follows and is logged every 60 ticks).

tags.name: Cloudiness
tags.documentation: Cloudiness override 0-1; negative = automatic (random walk + fronts).

tags.name: SetHour
tags.documentation: Hour-jump request consumed by the timer (negative = none); written by mg.set_hour.

tags.name: LastError
tags.documentation: Last timer error; cleared after 30 clean ticks.

tags.name: A1A
tags.documentation: Force inverter A1A into FAULT.

tags.name: A1B
tags.documentation: Force inverter A1B into FAULT.

tags.name: A2A
tags.documentation: Force inverter A2A into FAULT.

tags.name: A2B
tags.documentation: Force inverter A2B into FAULT.

tags.name: A3A
tags.documentation: Force inverter A3A into FAULT.

tags.name: A3B
tags.documentation: Force inverter A3B into FAULT.

tags.name: A4A
tags.documentation: Force inverter A4A into FAULT.

tags.name: A4B
tags.documentation: Force inverter A4B into FAULT.

tags.name: GridOut
tags.documentation: Utility intertie lost (grid_outage).

tags.name: Charger
tags.documentation: Charger number 1-10 forced into FAULT, 0 = none.

tags.name: B1
tags.documentation: Take BESS B1 offline (State OFF).

tags.name: B2
tags.documentation: Take BESS B2 offline (State OFF).

tags.name: LastEpochMs
tags.documentation: Epoch time of the previous tick (for dt).

tags.name: OkStreak
tags.documentation: Clean ticks since the last error.

tags.name: ScenarioApplied
tags.documentation: Scenario whose entry actions have been applied.

tags.name: ScenarioClock
tags.documentation: Simulated seconds since the scenario was applied.

tags.name: ScenarioStartDay
tags.documentation: DayIndex when the scenario started.

tags.name: DayOfYear
tags.documentation: Day of year 1-365 (sun declination, season, ambient mean).

tags.name: CloudBase
tags.documentation: Random-walk part of the cloudiness.

tags.name: HeatC
tags.documentation: Heat-wave offset added to ambient (peak_shave_day).

tags.name: IslandClockS
tags.documentation: Electrical seconds since the campus islanded.

tags.name: ResyncClockS
tags.documentation: Electrical seconds the grid has been back while still islanded.

tags.name: GenRunS
tags.documentation: Electrical seconds the genset has been RUNNING.

tags.name: GenCooldownS
tags.documentation: Electrical seconds in COOLDOWN.

tags.name: FreqDevHz
tags.documentation: Island frequency deviation state.

tags.name: VoltDevV
tags.documentation: Island voltage deviation state.

tags.name: B1
tags.documentation: B1 mode before islanding.

tags.name: B2
tags.documentation: B2 mode before islanding.

tags.name: BaselineDemandkW
tags.documentation: 15-minute average of the baseline load.

tags.name: EnergyCostUSD
tags.documentation: Net energy cost today (import less export credit).

tags.name: BaselineEnergyCostUSD
tags.documentation: Baseline energy cost today.

tags.name: TargetSOCPct
tags.documentation: Pre-peak SOC target the PEAK_SHAVE units charge to in the off-peak band.
